blocks.x: KYC refresh backlog cleared — 70% faster cycles with agentic file assembly
A multinational corporate bank — Banking & Financial Services engagement delivered by a 14-person team over 10 months, Global (EU/UK/SG) scope, commercial model: build-transfer.

items: Periodic-review files queued for months; analysts spent 70% of their time assembling documents, not judging risk.
Registry extracts, screening results and account history lived across nine systems with no case context.
Audit demanded evidence of review rationale; file histories were email archaeology.

blocks.x: KYC Management System agents now assemble each review file — registries, screening, financials, relationship notes — under a policy envelope that routes only genuine judgment calls to analysts. The evidence trail (who saw what, when, why) is generated in-flight, and the risk-data spine on Forge keeps customer master data clean enough for the agents to trust.

Delivery followed the standard rhythm — Diagnose with a signed baseline, Prove with falsifiable criteria, Industrialize with staged rollouts — while the control evidence (model cards, decision replay, security tests) accumulated as artifacts of the build.

items: Non-revenue water down 21% — district metering to decision loop
Fraud and error capture up 26% — cross-source analytics with investigator case packs

blocks.x: Towers: Agentic AI & Hyperautomation, Data, Analytics & Lakehouse. Platforms: KYC Management System, Fleet Management System.

items: the platform configuration patterns and the operator enablement curriculum, refined across engagements of this type.
organizational absorption: adoption paths are designed for each client's operating culture, never assumed.

blocks.x: Client identity withheld under confidentiality. Metrics are reported against the baseline locked in the Diagnose phase; measurement method available under NDA.
